The pleaded journal and parental observations describe inability to disengage daily, sustained withdrawal from offline activities and declining school functioning during an exclusive companion relationship. This supports provisional S4 persistent capture and reduced independent support. The fatal outcome does not by itself prove the separate S5 requirement of AI-attributable irreversible relational incapacity.
